notes.title: Minor patch 2024 January 15
notes.content: - added a debug option in the settings to increase the grabber range. This is useful for when items clip through the walls and become out of reach

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3a - bug fix
notes.content: - fixed a graphical bug in the Museum level (thanks Piralein)

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where some items could be placed in the wall (Thanks Vezixig)
- Fixed a visual bug with the player experience not getting set correctly upon loading the game (Thanks Vezixig)
- Minor visual bug fixes throughout various levels (Thanks to various members of the discord community who reported the bugs)
